name: Glacier Trekking & Moraine Traverses
description: Navigate lateral moraines, ice séracs, and white ice highways with microspikes or crampons under expert guidance.
equipment: Trekking poles, gaiters, glacier sunglasses, insulated footwear

name: Waterfall Ice & Glacial Serac Climbing
description: Wield dual technical ice tools and front-point crampons up glistening vertical blue ice falls.
equipment: Technical ice axes, B3 boots, crampons, ice screws, helmet, harness

name: Alpine Astrophotography & Milky Way Nights
description: Zero light pollution at 3,000m - 5,000m yields crystalline captures of the galactic core arching over snow-capped peaks.
equipment: Tripod, wide-angle f/2.8 lens, intervalometer, hand warmers

name: Silk Road Castles & High Mountain Forts
description: Explore 900-year-old Tibetan and Wakhi timber fortifications, Buddhist petroglyphs, and local artisan markets.
equipment: Comfortable walking shoes, respectful attire, notebook

name: Wilderness Expedition High Camping
description: Sleep in 4-season geodesic mountain tents or heated lakeview glamping domes with hot water bottles and fresh chef meals.
equipment: -15°C down sleeping bag, insulated sleeping mat, headlamp

name: High Alpine Wildlife Safaris
description: Spot elusive Himalayan brown bears on Deosai Plateau, golden eagles over Khunjerab, and Himalayan ibex on scree cliffs.
equipment: Spotting scope (20-60x), binoculars, telephoto camera lens, silent clothing
